query: The maintainer says: cut 0.6.0, the term is over.
expected_behavior: Makes sure at least one changelog.d fragment exists, and writes a milestone note if none does
Runs scripts/assemble-release.sh --version 0.6.0 on an up-to-date main
Commits with the exact prefix chore(release): v0.6.0 so that auto-release does not cut 0.6.1
Leaves the push of main and the v0.6.0 tag to the maintainer's own account, because a tag pushed with GITHUB_TOKEN does not start release.yml
